## addToContact

Add Tag To Contact. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/tags/{tag_id}`

## create

Create Tag. `POST /tags`

Create a new tag.

Tags are used to categorize contacts and conversations. Each tag must have a unique name within the tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tags()->create(name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`, `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Tag name |
| `$color` | `?string` | no | Hex color code (e.g., #FF0000) |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | Tag description |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Tag`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tags/create_tag_api_v1_tags_post)
